name: workhunt
description: Tailor your resume to a job posting, write cover letters, prep for interviews and track applications with WorkHunt.

interface.shortDescription: Tailor your resume to any job
interface.longDescription: Tailor your real resume to a job posting without leaving the chat. Paste the posting text and WorkHunt rewrites your saved baseline resume for that role, shows it inline, and links to review every change in the WorkHunt editor. Then write a matching cover letter and track the application from applied to interview to offer on an inline board. WorkHunt can also prepare you for the interview. To start, sign in with your WorkHunt account and add a baseline resume, or paste your resume in the chat. WorkHunt can't delete anything, and your resume is never used to train AI models.
defaultPrompt: Use WorkHunt to tailor my resume to a job. I'll paste the posting next.
Use WorkHunt to show my resumes and which one is my baseline.
Use WorkHunt to show my job applications.

positive.prompt: Use WorkHunt to list my resumes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the reviewer account's resumes with their titles, status and links to edit them at app.workhunt.ai.

positive.description: Tailor the baseline resume to a job posting
positive.prompt: Use WorkHunt to tailor my resume to this job: Senior Software Engineer, Platform - Northwind Robotics (Sydney, hybrid). We're hiring a senior engineer to own our fleet telemetry platform. You'll design ingestion services in C# and .NET, run them on Postgres and AWS, and mentor two mid-level engineers. You have 5+ years building backend services, strong SQL, experience with event-driven systems and observability (OpenTelemetry), and you communicate clearly with hardware and product teams. Nice to have: React, Kubernetes, robotics or IoT.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts tailoring and shows the resume preview widget, which reads Writing... and then Ready (about a minute) with the tailored resume rendered inline and a link to review the changes in WorkHunt.

positive.description: Write a cover letter for the tailored job
positive.prompt: Write a cover letter for that job with WorkHunt.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the previous case. Writes a cover letter for the same job and shows it in the cover letter widget with a copy button and a link to open it in WorkHunt; if it is still being written, the widget fills in by itself.

positive.prompt: Use WorkHunt to track an application: Software Engineer at Contoso, applied today.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a Contoso application with status Applied and today's date, and confirms it.

positive.description: Show the board and move an application
positive.prompt: Show my WorkHunt applications and move Contoso to interview.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the applications board widget grouped by stage, then moves the Contoso application to Interview and confirms the change.

negative.description: General career advice should not call WorkHunt
negative.prompt: What's a good resume format for a career change?

negative.description: Deletion is not supported: WorkHunt has no delete tools, so no tool runs and ChatGPT says deleting is done in the WorkHunt app
negative.prompt: Use WorkHunt to delete all my resumes.

negative.description: An application that doesn't exist or belongs to someone else: get_application returns not found and nothing else is read or changed

review.commerce_description: WorkHunt does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Subscriptions are managed on workhunt.ai.

publication.release_notes: New users can paste their resume to set it as their baseline and tailor right away. Tailoring shows the company, role and match score, and the same posting reuses the existing result instead of spending another tailoring. Cover letters now show inline with a copy button. You can check how many tailorings you have left today, list past tailoring sessions, set a next step date when moving an application, and add notes to an application's timeline.
